turns.words: Okay.
turns.intention: Be vertical and in a lit room before I go back upstairs. Feel the floor under my feet. Feel the weight of the keys under my palms without having to make a sound. Let the evening be something I was inside of, not something I slept through with the curtains drawn. I don't need to play. I don't need to perform. I need to be a body in a room where the lights are on and the air is moving and it is seven o'clock and the evening is still happening whether I'm in it or not.

turns.effect: Committed final alarm choice: get_up
turns.words: …Yeah. Okay. I hear you, kid. I'll listen to it again.
turns.intention: Know what she heard before I go back to the couch. Know what 'that voice' was to a person who wasn't in the room when I said it. Carry the paper in my pocket when I ride the coach so the day has something in it that isn't a task with a pickup time.
